content: Small-group suppression: SD Worx states the Directive sets NO EU-wide minimum group size; employers must apply judgement aligned with GDPR; guidance is to avoid publishing groups with fewer than 3-5 people, and to aggregate small groups into broader job families or mask figures. Secondary reporting says Germany's Advisory Commission has recommended a six-person minimum comparison group. Therefore 'fewer than six per sex' is a configurable heuristic, not a Directive rule.
